title: Databricks Platform
body: An unified data analytics platform built on Apache Spark that combines data engineering, data science, and business analytics. Provides integrated workspace for SQL, Python, Scala, R with collaborative notebooks and workflow orchestration.

title: Delta Lake
body: An open-source storage format built on Parquet that brings ACID transaction guarantees to data lakes. Enables schema enforcement, time travel, and unified batch/streaming processing; cornerstone of Databricks Lakehouse architecture.

title: Unity Catalog
body: Databricks' centralized metadata governance layer providing fine-grained access control, data lineage tracking, and unified governance across workspaces and clouds. Enables RBAC at table, row, and column level.

title: Databricks SQL
body: A native SQL engine optimized for analytical queries on data lakes. Provides sub-second query latency, automatic optimization, and full SQL compatibility with Delta Lake tables.

title: Databricks Jobs
body: Fully managed job scheduler for running notebooks, JAR files, Python scripts, or SQL queries on Databricks clusters. Supports scheduled runs, retry logic, notifications, and integration with external orchestrators.

title: Databricks Workflows
body: A directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based workflow orchestration system for coordinating multi-job pipelines. Replaces legacy job clusters with support for job dependencies, error handling, and notifications.

title: MLflow
body: An open-source ML platform for managing the ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, and model serving. Integrates with Databricks for collaborative ML development.

title: Lakehouse Architecture
body: A data architecture combining the benefits of data lakes (scalability, cost) and data warehouses (ACID guarantees, SQL performance). Delta Lake is the foundation; enables unified ETL and analytics.

title: Medallion Architecture
body: A best-practice data organization pattern with three layers: Bronze (raw data), Silver (cleaned/deduplicated), Gold (business-ready). Common in Databricks Lakehouses for progressive data refinement.

title: Schema Inference and Enforcement
body: Delta Lake automatically infers schemas from Parquet files and enforces them on writes. Prevents accidental schema changes and ensures data quality; enforced schemas can be modified with ALTER TABLE.

title: Time Travel (Data Versioning)
body: Delta Lake's capability to query previous versions of data using timestamps or version numbers. Enables audit trails, data recovery, and temporal analysis without additional snapshot tables.

title: Z-Order Clustering
body: A data layout optimization technique that co-locates related data to improve query performance. Particularly effective for queries filtering on multiple columns; automatically optimized by Databricks.

title: Photon Engine
body: Databricks' optimized query execution engine written in C++ for vectorized execution. Provides 3-8x performance improvement over standard Spark SQL for analytics workloads.

title: Cluster
body: A set of computation resources in Databricks: driver node (coordinates) + worker nodes (execute tasks). Can be all-purpose (interactive), job clusters (short-lived for jobs), or GPU clusters (ML workloads).

title: Notebook
body: Databricks' collaborative development environment supporting multiple languages (SQL, Python, Scala, R) in a single document. Includes cell-by-cell execution, visualization, and version control.

title: Secrets API
body: Databricks' secure credential storage system for managing passwords, API keys, tokens. Secrets are stored in encrypted backend and accessed via API; prevents hardcoding credentials in notebooks.
